title: Rust: stratum tracking (0-4)
description: Time stratum tracking 0-4. AC: Tracks stratum level, increments for each hop from authoritative source.
notes: Implemented no_std Rust TimeStratum (canonical wire values 0-4) and StratumTracker with explicit authoritative initialization, separately incremented authenticated relay-hop distance, fail-closed no-sync/overflow handling, and reset semantics. Current authoritative spec/09-packets-timing.md defines stratum as source quality (higher is better), so relay hops preserve the stratum rather than falsely relabeling GNSS/NTS/Roughtime provenance; this reconciles the bead's older hop-increment wording by tracking hops independently. Added canonical packets-timing.json vector consumption.
